# spargebra 0.4.7 / OE patches

Upstream registry source: Oxigraph commit `0e81a29d27575ab69e7f85ea9c7f1058b277fcd0`, `lib/spargebra`.
The first numeric correction patched only `src/parser.rs`; the later private arithmetic-chain increment also changes `src/algebra.rs` and adds a nondefault manifest feature, as described below. Original version and earlier patch identities remain retained.

The original recursive numeric grammar groups `a - b - c` as `a - (b - c)` and `a / b / c` as `a / (b / c)`. The patch folds each additive/multiplicative sequence from the left while preserving precedence and explicit parentheses, following [SPARQL 1.1 numeric expressions](https://www.w3.org/TR/sparql11-query/#grammar).

This is a local dependency correction, not an unmodified upstream release. Cargo uses this source for the v2 kernel and design validator. The separately built, source-locked official ggen is unchanged.

The private arithmetic-chain increment adds the explicitly selected, hidden `parse_query_rdflib760_nullable` entry under the nondefault `rdflib760-nullable-internal` feature. It preserves nonempty additive/multiplicative sequences before binary lowering, keeps parenthesized nonempty sequences nested and leaves bare-variable parentheses transparent. The original public/default parser policies remain binary. New algebra variants are appended; walking, group checks and diagnostic Display/SSE retain every operand and sequence boundary. This is a private receiving entry, not a public product query `/5` or complete RDFLib parser equivalence. Cross-component baseline identity and limitations are recorded in `../spareval/NULLABLE-CHAIN-PROVENANCE.json`.

Independent expectations are in `crates/oe-kernel/tests/arithmetic.rs`. The failure before correction is retained in the private maintenance records; unchanged package oracles also exercise material and work balances. Upgrading this dependency requires these regressions again.

The second local increment provides explicit `parse_query_rdflib760`. Ordinary `parse_query` retains its original selection defaults. The two DESCRIBE productions delegate to `build_describe`; under the explicit compatibility profile it preserves genuine target variables separately, adds the original RDFLib first-child projections only to modifier keys, and uses existing `build_select` to emit the real key `Project`, `Distinct`, then `Slice`. The returned target metadata prevents child key values from becoming resources to describe. SELECT, ASK and CONSTRUCT productions retain their behavior. Two equal projected `?s` keys become one before `OFFSET 1`, restoring the original empty result; nested `(s,tag)` keys retain distinct tag values and restore the original nested four-triple result. It never deduplicates individual resource nodes early or inserts application context into the key domain.

The original RDFLib [`translate`](https://github.com/RDFLib/rdflib/blob/7.6.0/rdflib/plugins/sparql/algebra.py) sets its Describe modifier to DISTINCT and applies it between projection and slicing. This is a finite original compatibility policy, not a claim that all Describe implementation choices are uniquely prescribed by [SPARQL 1.1](https://www.w3.org/TR/sparql11-query/#describe). Tied-order observations and original child-IRI target expansion are preserved separately; the compatibility key projection does not authorize unselected resources. Exact upstream parser SHA, pre-increment patched baseline SHA, both licenses and reference-source SHA are recorded in `DESCRIBE-PATCH-PROVENANCE.json`. Crate versions retain their original identity; the lock only adds the already pinned spareval as a direct semantic-runtime dependency, and the shared Cargo registry source is read-only.


The later variable `GROUP BY (?s AS ?group)` correction preserves the explicit alias instead of silently discarding it in the Variable expression branch. The same genuine parser builds Extend before Group; only a fresh query target can be assigned. External initial values remain application context and are handled by existing runtime profiles; query redeclaration is rejected. No profile4, second Dataset, source rewriting or aggregate/filter semantics change is introduced. Exact source/provenance/licenses and original74/source-bound independent controls are retained in `GROUP-ALIAS-PATCH-PROVENANCE.json`. Ordinary group variables/nonvariable expressions, arithmetic and Describe key/target domains retain their behavior.
